MCPCOMPANION.SettingTelemetryHint: Report your token selections, targets and viewed scene to the MCP server (per-client). Turn off to keep this client private.
MCPCOMPANION.SettingRunScriptHint: OFF by default, and it should usually stay off. When on, any MCP client connected to your gateway can run arbitrary JavaScript in this browser with your Gamemaster rights: read and alter every document, act as you, reach anything your session can reach. That code is often written by an AI model and is NOT reviewed by anyone before it runs. Each execution is printed in full to the browser console (F12) and announced on screen, so you can audit what ran. Only enable it if you trust every client holding your gateway secret, and turn it back off when you're done.
MCPCOMPANION.ScriptRan: A remote script was executed on this client — see the console (F12) for its full source.
